label: Eliezer

text.BHSA EZR 10:22: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י פַּשְׁח֑וּר אֶלְיֹועֵינַ֤י מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל נְתַנְאֵ֔ל יֹוזָבָ֖ד וְאֶלְעָשָֽׂה׃ ס
text.KJV EZR 10:22: And of the sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
text.BHSA EZR 10:23: וּמִֽן־הַלְוִיִּ֑ם יֹוזָבָ֣ד וְשִׁמְעִ֗י וְקֵֽלָיָה֙ ה֣וּא קְלִיטָ֔א פְּתַֽחְיָ֥ה יְהוּדָ֖ה וֶאֱלִיעֶֽזֶר׃ ס
text.KJV EZR 10:23: Also of the Levites; Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah, (the same is Kelita,) Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
text.BHSA EZR 10:24: וּמִן־הַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים אֶלְיָשִׁ֑יב וּמִן־הַשֹּׁ֣עֲרִ֔ים שַׁלֻּ֥ם וָטֶ֖לֶם וְאוּרִֽי׃ ס
text.KJV EZR 10:24: Of the singers also; Eliashib: and of the porters; Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.

A.name: Eliezer
A.line: Priest Ezra sent to Iddo (EZR 8:16), married a foreign wife (EZR 10:18, EZ 10:23)
family: descendant-of jeshua-3 (Jeshua, returned to Judah after the Babylonian captivity (EZR 2:2, N)
descendant-of levi (Levi, third-born son of Jacob (GEN 29:34), son of Leah)

B.name: Eliezer
B.line: A Levite who had married a foreign wife, distinct from the priestly and Harim Eliezers.

why: The Hebrew וּמִן־הַלְוִיִּם (“and of the Levites”) places Eliezer in the Levite list, matching B. A is identified as an Aaronic priest descended from Jeshua, belonging to the separate priestly group despite A’s conflicting citation of this verse.
